not_used.tile_size: it processes each image whole, orthos included.
not_used.overlap: it processes each image whole, with no tiles.
not_used.device: it runs on the processor only.
not_used.device_number: it runs on the processor only.
not_used.dedup: it processes each image whole, so nothing is found twice.

settings.label: Shadow threshold (share of the Otsu value)
settings.help: Pixels darker than this share of the Otsu value are shadow between grains. Higher: more shadow.

authors.source: PebbleCountsAuto.py -otsu_threshold: no default; the program asks for it on screen at each run

settings.differs_because: PebbleMapper runs without anyone at the screen, so a value must be given; 50 is PebbleMapper's choice and was not measured against other values.

settings.label: Minimum grain area
settings.help: Smaller grains are removed when the grain mask is cleaned. Higher: fewer specks.

authors.source: PebbleCountsAuto.py help: 10 for about 1 mm per pixel, 20 for images finer than 0.8 mm per pixel

settings.differs_because: kept at the program's default of 10; PebbleMapper's photographs are usually finer than 0.8 mm per pixel, for which the authors advise 20. Not yet measured here.

settings.label: Shortest grain kept (b-axis)
settings.help: Grains with a shorter b-axis are not counted. Higher: small grains are not counted.

settings.label: Largest overlap between neighbouring ellipses
settings.help: Grains whose ellipse overlaps a neighbour's by more are removed. Higher: more grains kept, some doubtful.

settings.label: Largest misfit between ellipse and grain
settings.help: Grains that fit their ellipse worse than this are removed. Higher: more irregular grains kept.

settings.label: First denoising strength
settings.help: Smooths the colours before edges are looked for. Higher: fewer false edges, fine detail lost.

settings.label: Top-hat edge percentile
settings.help: Percentile above which the top-hat filter marks an edge. Higher: fewer edges, grains merge more.

settings.label: Sobel edge percentile
settings.help: Percentile above which the Sobel filter marks an edge. Higher: fewer edges, grains merge more.

settings.label: Canny edge smoothing (sigma)
settings.help: Smoothing of the edge detection. Higher: fewer edges, grains merge more.

fixed.label: Ortho mode
fixed.reason: it needs choices made on screen; an ortho is processed as a photograph, whole, at its pixel size.

fixed.label: Sand mask and colour mask
fixed.reason: the program draws them interactively on screen; PebbleMapper answers 'no'.

fixed.label: Processor
fixed.reason: PebbleCountsAuto does not use the graphics card.
